purpose.zh: 拉伸小腿后侧，改善踝关节活动度
purpose.en: Stretch the back of the calf and improve ankle mobility.

text.zh: 后腿伸直，脚跟压地，髋部向墙靠
text.en: Keep the back leg straight, heel down, and lean your hips to the wall

text.zh: 后脚尖正对墙面，从脚跟到头成一条直线
text.en: Point your back toes at the wall and keep one line from heel to head.

text.zh: 拉伸感出现就停住，慢慢呼吸再稍微退回
text.en: Hold once you feel the stretch, breathe slowly, then ease back a little.

commonErrors.zh: 后脚跟离地或后膝弯曲
commonErrors.en: Lifting the back heel or bending the back knee.
Sagging the lower back and only pushing the hips forward.

cautions.zh: 疼痛时减小前倾幅度，仍痛就停止
cautions.en: Lean less if it hurts, and stop if the pain continues.
